seo.titleZH: Seed 芥子 — WebAssembly 字节码保护工具
seo.descriptionZH: Seed 芥子是一款 WebAssembly 字节码保护工具，帮助开发者将编译后的程序进行深度加固，防止逆向工程、代码窃取和未授权使用。
seo.descriptionEN: Seed is a WebAssembly bytecode protection tool that deeply hardens compiled programs against reverse engineering, code theft, and unauthorized use.
seo.keywords: WebAssembly, wasm, bytecode protection, code obfuscation, reverse engineering, code security, Seed, 芥子, 字节码保护, 代码混淆
